title: Matched FP8 projections: E4M3 weights (MXFP8, 128 x 128 or row scales) against per-group E4M3 activations, decode rows and a prompt GEMM with the same bits for every output

rows.what: decode rows: a CTA 16 weight rows of one job of 1 to 8 tokens, the 16 lanes split over its warps (one e4m3 m16n8k32 MMA a 32-element block), the halving tree in shared memory; an alias of decode-gemv's rows-fp8-block (the Python rows forward there: the same kernel, the same bits; this structure's tuning applies to it, its sweep tunes it)

WARPS.what: warps a CTA (16 lanes over them: 4, 2 or 1 lanes a warp)

AHEAD.what: rounds of weight and activation loads in flight ahead of the MMAs

yardstick.library: cuBLASLt's MXFP8 GEMM (torch._scaled_mm, E4M3 with blocked E8M0 scales, FP32 output); the activations' power-of-two group scales converted to E8M0 once outside the timed call, the global 0.5 left out

gemm.what: prompt GEMM: a warp 16 weight rows x 8 TILES tokens a pass, lane by lane in the tree's order (one e4m3 m16n8k32 MMA a block and n-tile), folded as the lanes finish; token tiles over grid.z

WARPS.what: warps a CTA (16 weight rows each)

TILES.what: n-tiles of 8 tokens a warp computes a pass, sharing the weight fragment

UNROLL.what: unroll of a lane's block loop (0: the compiler's choice)

yardstick.library: cuBLASLt's MXFP8 GEMM (torch._scaled_mm, E4M3 with blocked E8M0 scales, FP32 output); the activations' power-of-two group scales converted to E8M0 once outside the timed call, the global 0.5 left out

gemm-staged.what: prompt GEMM with shared-memory staging: a CTA BM weight rows x BN tokens, the blocks visited lane by lane in the tree's order through a STAGES-deep cp.async ring, a warp BM / WM rows x BN / WN tokens (one e4m3 m16n8k32 MMA with a zero accumulator a 16 x 8 tile and block), each lane folded into the tree as it finishes: the declared order's bits, the same as gemm and rows

WM.what: warps along the rows (a warp BM / WM rows)

WN.what: warps along the tokens (a warp BN / WN tokens)

GROUP.what: lanes of the tree a stage carries a block of (sibling lanes folded together: fewer barriers a block)

RUN.what: blocks of each lane a stage carries, in the lane's order (fewer barriers a block, no more registers)

STAGES.what: stages of the shared-memory ring (STAGES - 1 in flight; one value swept, the template takes 3 and more)

yardstick.library: cuBLASLt's MXFP8 GEMM (torch._scaled_mm, E4M3 with blocked E8M0 scales, FP32 output); the activations' power-of-two group scales converted to E8M0 once outside the timed call, the global 0.5 left out

gemm-native.what: prompt GEMM accumulated in the tensor cores, NOT the declared order: a CTA TM tokens x TN weight rows, a STAGES-deep cp.async ring of swizzled BK-byte tiles (kernel core tile.cuh), ldmatrix fragments; MXFP8 throughout (mx) on sm_120a: kind::mxf8f6f4 block-scaled m16n8k32 MMAs, the scales applied and every block summed in the FP32 accumulator; otherwise an e4m3 MMA a block with the scales on the CUDA cores. An output's bits depend on the tile and the token count

TN.what: weight rows a CTA (the MMA's N)

WM.what: warps along the tokens (a warp TM / WM tokens)

WN.what: warps along the weight rows (a warp TN / WN rows)

BK.what: bytes of every row a stage (the K step of the ring)

STAGES.what: stages of the cp.async ring (STAGES - 1 in flight)

GROUP.what: weight-row tiles a group of the CTA order (the CTAs that run together share their rows)

EPI.what: epilogue: 0 the accumulators stored from registers while the CTA's next tile loads, 1 staged through shared memory as whole rows

gemm-native.order: the tensor core's: each MMA sums its 32-element block with its scales into the FP32 accumulator, blocks in increasing order (not the declared per-lane order and tree)

yardstick.library: cuBLASLt's MXFP8 GEMM (torch._scaled_mm, E4M3 with blocked E8M0 scales, FP32 output); the activations' power-of-two group scales converted to E8M0 once outside the timed call, the global 0.5 left out

gemm-native-channel.what: prompt GEMM of matrices whose scales do not change along K (an FP8 checkpoint's per-channel W8A8: one FP32 scale a weight row, one a token), NOT the declared order: a CTA TM tokens x TN weight rows, a STAGES-deep cp.async ring of swizzled BK-byte code tiles (no scales in the mainloop), every block summed in the tensor cores' FP32 accumulator (on sm_120a the block-scaled e4m3 MMA with unit scales, twice the plain MMA's rate), token scale x weight scale x post in the epilogue, FP32 or BF16 out rounded once. An output's bits depend on the tile and the token count

TN.what: weight rows a CTA (the MMA's N)

WM.what: warps along the tokens (a warp TM / WM tokens)

WN.what: warps along the weight rows (a warp TN / WN rows)

BK.what: bytes of every row a stage (the K step of the ring)

STAGES.what: stages of the cp.async ring (STAGES - 1 in flight)

GROUP.what: weight-row tiles a group of the CTA order (the CTAs that run together share their rows)

EPI.what: epilogue: 0 the scaled outputs stored from registers while the CTA's next tile loads, 1 staged through shared memory as whole rows

gemm-native-channel.order: the tensor core's: each MMA sums its 32-element block into the FP32 accumulator, blocks in increasing order; the scales applied once to the sum

yardstick.library: cuBLASLt's FP8 GEMM with row-wise scales (torch._scaled_mm, E4M3 operands, scale_a [tokens, 1] and scale_b [1, rows] FP32, BF16 output) on the same bytes

gemm-native-blocks.what: prompt GEMM of scales that change along K (an FP8 block checkpoint's 128 x 128 FP32 block scales against activations quantized per group, MXFP8 matrices against activations whose scales are not powers of two; gemm_native(mx=False) for every table but a channel-scaled one), NOT the declared order: a CTA TM tokens x TN weight rows, a STAGES-deep cp.async ring of swizzled BK-byte code tiles and a STAGES + 1 slot ring of the stage's FP32 scales, each scale span's MMAs (the run of 32-element blocks over which neither operand's scale changes) summed in the tensor cores (on sm_120a the block-scaled e4m3 MMA with unit scales), one FMA a span with the span's activation x weight scale; a scale constant along K and post in the epilogue, FP32 or BF16 out rounded once. An output's bits depend on the tile and the scale layout

TN.what: weight rows a CTA (the MMA's N)

WM.what: warps along the tokens (a warp TM / WM tokens)

WN.what: warps along the weight rows (a warp TN / WN rows)

BK.what: bytes of every row a stage (the K step of the ring)

STAGES.what: stages of the cp.async code ring (STAGES - 1 in flight; the scale ring holds STAGES + 1)

GROUP.what: weight-row tiles a group of the CTA order (the CTAs that run together share their rows)

EPI.what: epilogue: 0 the outputs stored from registers while the CTA's next tile loads, 1 staged through shared memory as whole rows

gemm-native-blocks.order: the tensor core's within a scale span (each MMA adds its 32-element block into the span's FP32 sum, blocks in increasing order), then one FMA a span into the output's FP32 sum, spans in increasing order; scales constant along K applied once after

yardstick.library: cuBLASLt's MXFP8 GEMM (torch._scaled_mm, E4M3 with blocked E8M0 scales per 32 on both operands, BF16 output) on the same codes: cuBLASLt has no FP8 GEMM with FP32 128 x 128 / 1 x 128 block scales on sm_120 (CUBLAS_STATUS_NOT_SUPPORTED, torch 2.14.1), so its block-scaled MXFP8 GEMM is the yardstick
